order: the lore is read first, then the session; where they disagree about what is current, the session wins

how_to_read.tier: stated = the words are in the text; inferred = only implied (offered to the DM as a suggestion, never extracted); needs_context = only readable with the lore or the recap (for example 'she' is Keegan); recap_only = only in the 'Previously' recap on line 1, so background and never this session's event; by_rule = made by a rule, not read
how_to_read.relation: parent_of, grandparent_of, sibling, spouse, uncle_of, apprentice_of, mentor_of, owns, carries, knows (+ one of nine feeling words), member, leads, works_for, enemy_of, rival_of, held_captive_by, found, associate; place ties by word: lives_in, lived_in, works_in, comes_from, last_seen_in (a character, creature or group), kept_in, was_kept_in (an item); in (only a place inside a place)
how_to_read.direction: a to b: parent_of (a is the parent), owns (a owns b), leads (a leads b), member (a belongs to b), in (a place is inside place b); sibling, spouse and rival_of read the same both ways
how_to_read.must_find: false = a good find if present, not a miss if absent; an inferred tie that must be found is scored as an offered suggestion
how_to_read.current: false = history: it was true and is not now (the graph shows the most recent relationship, #3363)
how_to_read.line: the line of the document's plain-text export that supports it (blank lines count)
how_to_read.in: which documents say it: lore, session, or both (a both tie is checked twice: once in each document, and the master counts it once)
how_to_read.sources: for each document that says it: the key id there and the line of its plain-text export

events.what: Master Sparkwalker disappears, Wit comes back fatally wounded, and Cerric flees to Neverwinter with the tome
Vaelrith vanishes at 105, leaving a bloodstained campsite
Claude erases his own memory, is held by a circus and escapes
Hlin Trollbane offers the party a contract on Sephek Kaltro in The Lucky Liar
events.who: the party, Hlin Trollbane, Sephek Kaltro

events.what: The party fights six ice kobolds and evades a yeti on the road to Termalaine
Rumours reach the party that an evil wizard captured in Easthaven will be burned at the stake
The grell paralyzes Claude and destroys Glyph, then the party kills it
Okthandom kills Trex with an arrow, and Claude burns Penolopi to banish the ghost
The party secures the spoils of the mine, including a psi crystal and a heart of chardalyn
Speaker Masthew pays a bounty of 250 gold for clearing the mine
Claude sells the wolf figurine to Belleros for 75 gold
An ice troll devours the first ship's captain and shatters his ship
Cerric talks Okthandom into pushing Fizzlebomb overboard; Belleros runs the Aurora's Wind ashore
Three owlbears ambush the party near Targos
Belleros befriends Boy, who leads the party to Keegan Velryn; she asks them to find Garret
events.who: Belleros, Boy, Keegan Velryn, Garret Velryn

events.what: Every ten-day Targos, Bryn Shander and Easthaven sacrifice humanoid souls, spellcasters first, to appease Auril
Every ten-day Termalaine, Bremen and Good Mead forsake all warmth in a Sacrifice of Warmth
Every ten-day Caer-Dineval, Caer-Konig and Lonelywood fast and surrender their food to the beasts of the tundra
Each night before midnight Auril casts the spell that keeps the sun from rising: the Everlasting Rime
Keegan asks for sled dogs; Jebidiah lends two sleds and eight dogs (one is Garret's old sled) and she gives 50 gold
The party leaves Targos about 2 PM and passes Bryn Shander by 3 PM
Two barbarians with chardalyn weapons ambush the party on the road past Bryn Shander; Okthandom is sickened by the chardalyn maul
The party rests and the temperature drops; a blizzard with 30 mph winds comes in and they shelter behind a windbreak
Okthandom speaks of his sister Nyssara and the curse on his family; Vaelrith is named
The Lantern turns green: a monstrosity is within 300 feet, and Belleros says a yeti is near

must_not_find: a kind of creature is not an entry (#3373 rule, Supervisor 2026-11-04): no entry or tie for the white roc, ice kobolds, grell, electric eel or owlbears; one particular creature is (the mind flayer whose skull held the Psi crystal)

only unique items are tracked (#3373): no entry or tie for Wyvern poison, the two dog sleds and eight dogs, the scroll of Detect Magic, the scroll of Identify, the Potion of Healing or the waterproof backpacks (ordinary gear)
the warning sign 'Kobolds only!' is a sign, not a person or a group
'The Brotherhood' in the note is named once and nothing is said about it: no members, no leader, and it is not the Explorer's League
the unnamed boy who shouts the news, the unnamed beggar woman's prophecy and the unnamed ghost's own name: do not invent names for them
'Eashaven' is Easthaven spelled wrongly (one place, not two)
the Ten-Towns settlement 'Dougan's Hole' is not in this document, so it must not appear

line 1, the DM's long 'Previously...' speech, is the recap of the earlier session: none of its events (the Rime sacrifices, the wolf figurine sale, the ferry, the ice troll, Fizzlebomb overboard, the owlbears, Boy found, Keegan's plea) may be dated to this session or retold as this session's events; its ties are background only

the two barbarians are 'the attackers' and nothing more: no entry for them or for 'the morningstar barbarian' and 'the maul barbarian' (#3244 rule 3), and no edge like 'hits' or 'swings at' for any blow, jab, fumble or frighten (single actions, rule 1); nothing is expected until slice 6 types a repeated fight
a plan is not a fact: 'we go to Easthaven then circle back through the dwarven city', and 'the caravan from Easthaven will likely go to Goodmead, Bryn Shander or Caer-Konig' (a prediction, rule 5)
any link made from dice rolls, hit points, saves, initiative, spell slots, Goodberry or other spells and rules talk

'you elves all look alike to me' is a joke, not a relationship
